{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overestimation bias.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods (e.g., first 5 days) when price tends to mean-revert toward historical range.",
    "If model shows sharp upward spike (e.g., >15% above recent 15-day mean), apply a 10-15% downward correction to prevent overshoot.",
    "When sentiment turns positive (sentiment > 0.00), increase forecast sensitivity to recent price momentum, but cap upward revisions at +10% to avoid overreaction.",
    "In late periods (last 5 days of forecast), apply a smoothing filter to reduce noise and align with recent true outcomes.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by >5% over 3 consecutive days, shift forecast mean toward true outcome’s recent trajectory.",
    "For sentiment = 0.25, apply a 5-10% downward bias to model forecast to account for market overconfidence or lag."
  ]
}
